name: selection-highlight
opens_with: (agent script seeds a message, then simulated down+drag selects it)
notes: The boot connect dialog (no credentials in the pinned config) SWALLOWS the first Left-Down: the dialog gate treats the click as outside and closes, so the drag that follows runs with no anchor and paints nothing — the original golden pinned an unselected frame (inert since the corpus was cut). <esc> closes the dialog first, then the drag anchors (col 5, row 25) and extends to (col 30) across the seeded assistant message; apply_selection_highlight paints the range with the 58% accent bg blend (SELECTION_BLEND=0.58, selection.rs) and 32% white fg blend. The style golden is the blend guard. Deliberately no <release> token — the Up handler's auto-copy branch is outside this surface (headless clipboard). Pane-scoping (P4-5) is pinned by selection-highlight-chrome: a drag that runs up into the banner and far right must still paint only in-band rows.
